description.value:
This clunky, old-fashioned VR headset supposedly plunges the wearer into the realm of the supernatural, displaying a world totally unlike the one you're presently in, though the size and vague shape of walls and obstacles remain the same. This world often resembles places or events important to nearby incorporeal undead, such as a burning building or how a station appeared decades ago.

Activate—Goggles On 1 (manipulate) You pull the headset over your eyes and power it on, plunging you into its simulated supernatural world. All corporeal creatures are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] to you, but you can clearly see any incorporeal creatures, such as ghosts and the denizens of the Ethereal Plane. You also gain a +1 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] about the past of any undead creature within 1,000 feet. You can end the effect by raising the headset as a single Interact action.
